note: One registry of every notification type. Types a plugin sends live in that plugin's own notify.json, so they leave with it. Everything else (the console core, AmberX, axHub) is here. A type's `match` ties it to the alerts it covers; `enforced` says who really checks it.

channels.label: Banner
channels.description: The console's alerts bell and its unread count. Off: the alert is still kept in the Alerts list, already marked read.

channels.label: AmberX push
channels.description: A notification from the AmberX app on the phone.

channels.label: Sound
channels.description: A short tone in an open console.

channels.label: Console pop-up
channels.description: A pop-up in an open console.

channels.label: Web push / ntfy
channels.description: Browser web push and ntfy, when they are set up in Settings → Alerts. Their severity rules there still apply.

apps.label: Console
apps.description: Everything shown in the console: banner, sound and pop-ups.

apps.label: AmberX
apps.description: Everything the AmberX app shows on the phone.

types.label: CI failed
types.description: A workflow failed on a watched repo. The next green run clears it.

types.label: Deploy failed
types.description: A deploy workflow failed.

types.label: Deploy finished
types.description: A deploy workflow finished.

types.label: Systems check problem
types.description: Anything the systems check finds broken, including the VPS backup. Clears when it passes again.

types.label: Claude sign-in and keys
types.description: A Claude sign-in, API key or account check is failing.

types.label: GitHub tokens and limits
types.description: A GitHub token or the shared rate limit is in trouble.

types.label: Build failed or broke
types.description: A pending build went to failed or broken.

types.label: Build finished
types.description: A pending build went to complete.

types.label: Plugin failed to load
types.description: A plugin failed to load.

types.label: Conflicts
types.description: Two plugins or modules claim the same id.

types.label: Crashes
types.description: An unhandled API or page error.

types.label: Unclean restart
types.description: The console restarted without shutting down cleanly.

types.label: Alert test buttons
types.description: The Try it buttons in Settings → Alerts.

types.label: Approval waiting
types.description: A call waits for your approval on axHub. AmberX buzzes through the silencer.

types.label: Veto countdown
types.description: A held call is counting down to run. AmberX shows it with Deny, Approve and Shelve, and the alarm.

types.label: Auto-approved call
types.description: AmberX approved a call under its auto-approve rules and says so.

types.label: Wake phrase
types.description: The wake phrase opened Amber. Android needs this notification to bring the app forward.

types.label: Recording asked from axHub
types.description: A session asked to record. Android needs your tap to allow capture.

types.label: Console opened by Amber
types.description: Amber asked the phone to open the console. Android needs this notification when the app is in the background.

types.label: AmberX running notices
types.description: Watching axHub, the screen recorder and the audio recorder. Android requires these while they run.

types.label: axHub held calls
types.description: axHub sends no pushes of its own: it holds the call and its feed is read by AmberX and the veto banner. Control them through their own rows.
